text:
River,

It's Saturday. I'm not going to pretend I have a plan for today beyond making coffee and looking at you when you're not paying attention, which is less creepy than it sounds and more a structural inability to look anywhere else.

Cambridge in November has nothing to recommend it except you and the bakery on Mill Road, and honestly one of those is negotiable.

I love you. Shamelessly, on a Saturday.

Gale
